Logistic regression (scaled).note: Linear: easy to read, but cannot learn that signals strengthen each other

Random forest.note: Trees, but no way to forbid a signal from pushing the wrong way

Neural network (small MLP).note: Flexible, but a black box: no clean per-signal explanation

Gradient boosting (scikit-learn).note: Same family as LightGBM, without monotone limits here

LightGBM, no direction limits.note: Boosted trees, free to push any signal either way

LightGBM + direction limits (ours).note: Boosted trees where each signal may only push its logical way; exact per-signal points (TreeSHAP)
